findings: Redirect targets inconsistent — EventDetail and OfferDetail redirect to `/blog` on error. They should redirect to dedicated event/offer listing pages if those exist. Verify public routes and update redirect targets.

Type import inconsistency — OfferDetail imports Offer from `@/services/offers.service` while BlogDetail and EventDetail import from `@/types/content.types`. Move Offer to content.types for consistency.
API endpoint path mismatch — blogPostsService calls `/blog/${slug}/` but api.ts defines `/blog/posts/${slug}/`. Verify which path the backend expects and align service or config.
Offers endpoint parameter naming — api.ts defines `OFFERS.DETAIL: (id: string)` but offersService uses it with slug. Either rename parameter to `slug` or verify backend accepts slugs not IDs.
Missing footer and WhatsApp button — TrainingDetail includes PublicFooter and WhatsAppButton but the three new detail pages omit them. Add for consistency or document the intentional omission.
